comment.narrative: Activity completed. UNOCT conducted a comprehensive needs assessment jointly with the Government of Uganda Ministry of ICT and National Guidance MICTNG to understand the broad challenges and needs faced by government communication officers as well as specific needs regarding training in PCVE strategic communication. UNOCT conducted a CSO survey to better integrate the perspectives and needs of civil society an additional survey was launched jointly with the Civil Society Coalition Against Violent Extremism CISCAVE from August to September 2023. In total 13 CSO representatives 4 women 9 men working on PCVE strategic communication in Uganda responded including CSOs located in remote regions of the country. This survey focused on assessing specific needs regarding training in PCVE strategic communication.
